question: At the exact functionmix midpoint and deployed c_fc update radius, does solving the existing 64-stage skew parent plus 24-stage symmetric-shear residual coordinates jointly remove the coordinate-interference gap seen in the sequential chart?
authorization: One zero-persistent-update mixed-coordinate diagnostic only. No training, learned basis, LoRA, HyperConnection, residual-topology change, larger rung, watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat is authorized.

protocol.topology: Select the exact deployed task-matched 64-stage skew parent. Apply its diagonal production fit only to select the exact deployed 24-stage symmetric-shear residual pairings. Flatten those fixed pairings into 135,168 coordinates and solve their linear tangents simultaneously with diagonal-preconditioned CG.
protocol.fixed_radius: Materialize the joint tangent plus accepted historical outer decay, then globally normalize its BF16 endpoint across all c_fc layers to the actual deployed production c_fc Frobenius norm. The c_proj residual-64 calibration arm is independently normalized to the deployed c_proj norm.
protocol.same_replay_state: Construct the production reconstruction, dense c_fc oracle, mixed solve, and c_proj-64 calibration from one gradient, clipped state, persisted momentum, functional context, and base model. Take the actual production optimizer steps only after all alternatives are built.
protocol.exact_restore: Restore every BF16 materialized MLP tensor around every candidate and persist zero model or optimizer updates to the checkpoint.

decision_rule.reliable_improvement: Candidate-minus-production 99% CI upper bound below zero and negative mean on every held-out window.
decision_rule.oracle_gate: Equal-radius dense c_fc must reliably beat production both alone and when substituted beside production c_proj on these new held-out windows.
decision_rule.mixed_pass: The mixed joint c_fc solve must reliably beat production both alone and beside production c_proj, recover at least 25% of the same-window dense c_fc oracle gap in the worse attribution, and at least 40% on average.
decision_rule.cproj64_role: Residual-64 c_proj is a calibration control only. Its result cannot rescue or authorize the mixed c_fc candidate.
decision_rule.architecture_gate: A pass authorizes implementation and a performance preflight only; it does not directly authorize training or a larger rung.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling only; no watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat
